The recurve bow has a fair attack speed, a fair range, and good accuracy. The hornbow provides a poor attack speed, a fair range, and fair accuracy, but has armor penetration.

— Tablet of Wisdom
 

There are five types of bows, and each has different advantages and disadvantages. The longbow has a medium attack speed, long range, and medium accuracy. The flatbow has a fast attack speed, long range, but poor accuracy. The horn bow has a slow attack speed, medium range, medium accuracy, and 10% armor penetration. name: Shield
wiki_extract:
A shield is an off-hand weapon that provides a bonus to a character's overall armor rating (AR). They can take up to two upgrades; in Nightfall and Eye of the North, these are provided via an inscription and a shield handle.
The maximum AR for a shield without any attribute requirement is 8; it can be as high as 16 with an appropriate rank in Strength, Tactics, Leadership, Command, Motivation or Fast Casting (in case of the Anniversary Shield "Curtain"). The rules that determine the bonus for characters that do not meet the minimum rank are complicated; see below for details.

name: Unique item
wiki_extract:
A unique item, also known simply as a "unique" or as a "green item" for its color in the inventory, is an item considered special and difficult to obtain. Most uniques are weapons, shields, or focus items, usually named after and dropped by a specific boss. Some unique items are drops from certain non-boss foes in specific areas, or rewards for finishing a campaign.
Unique weapons and focus items have the maximum possible values for their bonuses (except the Ogre-Slaying Knife, Keiran's Bow, Xan Hei's Resolve,Gesshoku and those from Shing Jea Island and Istan; Firebrand, Hahan's Oath and Kantoh's Walking Stick have a 5-energy bonus that is unnecessarily conditional). They can be customized and identified, but neither upgraded nor salvaged (except Keiran's Bow) nor dyed (except the  Straw Effigy, Torivos' Rage, and Traveler's Bo Staff). Most of them, including all dropped items, have a merchant value of 35 before identification, while some others have no merchant value and cannot be sold...
